findings.description: Formal plans filed for the 1.5 million sq ft Fifty at First office tower at 50 First Street. The article is cut off by the paywall after the lede, so the date, the filing and the parcel cannot be confirmed from what is readable.

citation.label: The Registry, “San Francisco Recovery Fund Files Formal Plans for 1.5MM SQFT Fifty at First Office Tower, Holds Hotel and Housing Tower in Reserve,” 15 October 2026

raw.text: Files Formal Plans for 1.5MM SQFT Fifty at First Office Tower

publish.note: Declined: paywall cuts off after the lede, so nothing can be extracted or checked. The headline also covers two addresses (50 First and 528 Mission); a later account or the planning filing can carry it.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 50 01ST ST → parcel 3708055; sf-parcels has blklot 3708055 active, 42–50 01ST; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use, built 1917. EAS puts 42, 50 01ST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 42. The record spells the street out as FIRST; EAS holds the numbered streets as zero-padded ordinals, so this is 01ST.

publish.note: Blocked: 1155 Market is a commercial condominium on four active parcels (3702820-3702823); the directory contract defers those. Same blocker as 2026-08-28b-0001. Revisit if a page for the building appears.

resolution.method: sf-eas-addresses has 1155 MARKET ST but it does not join to one parcel. 1155 MARKET ST's coordinates fall in 4 active parcels (3702821, 3702823, 3702822, 3702820), which is what a condominium looks like in sf-parcels: one parcel per unit, none of them the building.
resolution.note: The address is a condominium today, and the directory contract in the root AGENTS.md defers those: each unit has its own parcel and none of them is the building the record names.
